content: When Elijah told Elisha to stay behind, what did Elisha answer?
explanation: He said it three times. “As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live, I will not leave you.” (2 Kings 2:2, BSB)

content: How did Elijah part the waters of the Jordan?
explanation: The two crossed on dry ground. “And Elijah took his cloak, rolled it up, and struck the waters” (2 Kings 2:8, BSB)

content: Before Elijah was taken away, what did Elisha ask to inherit?
options: A double portion of his spirit
explanation: Elijah said it was a hard request. “Please, let me inherit a double portion of your spirit” (2 Kings 2:9, BSB)

content: What appeared and separated Elijah from Elisha?
explanation: It had horses of fire. “suddenly a chariot of fire with horses of fire appeared and separated the two of them” (2 Kings 2:11, BSB)

content: How did Elijah go up into heaven?
explanation: He did not die. “and Elijah went up into heaven in a whirlwind.” (2 Kings 2:11, BSB)

content: After Elijah went up to heaven, what did Elisha pick up?
explanation: It had fallen from Elijah. “Elisha also picked up the cloak that had fallen from Elijah” (2 Kings 2:13, BSB)

content: When Elisha struck the Jordan with Elijah's cloak, what happened?
explanation: God was with Elisha now. “And when he had struck the waters, they parted to the right and to the left, and Elisha crossed over.” (2 Kings 2:14, BSB)

content: What did the woman of Shunem persuade Elisha to do when he passed by?
explanation: She was kind to the prophet. “a prominent woman who lived there persuaded him to have a meal.” (2 Kings 4:8, BSB)

content: What did the Shunammite woman and her husband make for Elisha?
explanation: It had a bed, table, chair, and lamp. “Please let us make a small room upstairs and put in it a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp for him.” (2 Kings 4:10, BSB)

content: What was the name of Elisha's servant at the Shunammite woman's house?
explanation: He called the woman for Elisha. “And he said to Gehazi his servant, “Call the Shunammite woman.”” (2 Kings 4:12, BSB)

content: What did the kind Shunammite woman not have?
explanation: Her husband was old. “Well, she has no son” (2 Kings 4:14, BSB)

content: What did Elisha promise the Shunammite woman?
explanation: God kept the promise. “At this time next year, you will hold a son in your arms.” (2 Kings 4:16, BSB)

content: When Elisha prayed over the Shunammite's son, what did the boy do?
explanation: Then he opened his eyes. “and the boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.” (2 Kings 4:35, BSB)

content: After the boy came back to life, what did Elisha tell the Shunammite woman?
explanation: She bowed at his feet. “Pick up your son.” (2 Kings 4:36, BSB)

content: Who was Naaman?
explanation: He was great, but had leprosy. “Now Naaman, the commander of the army of the king of Aram, was a great man” (2 Kings 5:1, BSB)

content: What disease did the army commander Naaman have?
explanation: He was mighty, yet sick. “And he was a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.” (2 Kings 5:1, BSB)

content: Who told Naaman's wife about the prophet who could heal him?
explanation: She served Naaman's wife. “If only my master would go to the prophet who is in Samaria, he would cure him of his leprosy.” (2 Kings 5:3, BSB)

content: How many times did Elisha tell Naaman to wash in the Jordan?
explanation: Then he would be clean. “Go and wash yourself seven times in the Jordan” (2 Kings 5:10, BSB)

content: How did Naaman first react to Elisha's message to wash in the Jordan?
explanation: He expected something grand. “But Naaman went away angry” (2 Kings 5:11, BSB)

content: After dipping in the Jordan, what was Naaman's skin like?
explanation: He was clean. “and his flesh was restored and became like that of a little child, and he was clean.” (2 Kings 5:14, BSB)

content: When healed Naaman offered Elisha a gift, what did Elisha do?
explanation: God's healing was free. “I will not accept it.” (2 Kings 5:16, BSB)

content: How old was Josiah when he became king of Judah?
explanation: He reigned thirty-one years. “Josiah was eight years old when he became king” (2 Kings 22:1, BSB)
tags: King Josiah Finds the Book of the Law

content: How did young King Josiah live?
explanation: He walked in David's ways. “And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD” (2 Kings 22:2, BSB)
tags: King Josiah Finds the Book of the Law

content: In King Josiah's time, what did the high priest find in the temple?
explanation: It had been forgotten. “I have found the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD!” (2 Kings 22:8, BSB)
tags: King Josiah Finds the Book of the Law

content: When King Josiah heard the Book of the Law read, what did he do?
explanation: He was grieved by Judah's sin. “When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his clothes” (2 Kings 22:11, BSB)
tags: King Josiah Finds the Book of the Law

content: What did King Josiah read to all the people in the temple?
explanation: Everyone, small and great, heard it. “and in their hearing he read all the words of the Book of the Covenant” (2 Kings 23:2, BSB)
tags: King Josiah Finds the Book of the Law

content: What did King Josiah make before the LORD after reading the law?
explanation: All the people joined it. “So the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD” (2 Kings 23:3, BSB)
tags: King Josiah Finds the Book of the Law

content: How did King Josiah turn to the LORD?
explanation: No king was like him. “who turned to the LORD with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength” (2 Kings 23:25, BSB)
tags: King Josiah Finds the Book of the Law

content: As Elijah went up, what did Elisha cry out?
explanation: He called him the chariots of Israel. “My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!” (2 Kings 2:12, BSB)

content: What sign did Elijah give that Elisha would receive a double portion?
explanation: Elisha did see it. “if you see me as I am taken from you, it will be yours.” (2 Kings 2:10, BSB)

content: When a poor widow asked Elisha for help, what did she have in her house?
explanation: God multiplied it. “Your servant has nothing in the house but a jar of oil.” (2 Kings 4:2, BSB)

content: In the miracle of the widow's oil, when did the oil stop flowing?
options: When there were no more jars
explanation: She sold it to pay her debt. “But he replied, “There are no more jars.” Then the oil stopped flowing.” (2 Kings 4:6, BSB)

content: Which rivers did Naaman think were better than Israel's waters?
explanation: They were rivers of Damascus. “Are not the Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel?” (2 Kings 5:12, BSB)

content: Who persuaded angry Naaman to wash in the Jordan?
explanation: They called it a simple command. “Naaman’s servants, however, approached him” (2 Kings 5:13, BSB)

content: What happened to Gehazi after he chased Naaman for a gift?
explanation: Naaman's leprosy clung to him. “And as Gehazi left his presence, he was leprous—as white as snow.” (2 Kings 5:27, BSB)

content: When a borrowed axe head fell into the water, what did Elisha make it do?
explanation: He threw a stick in the water. “the man of God cut a stick, threw it there, and made the iron float.” (2 Kings 6:6, BSB)

content: When God opened his servant's eyes, what did he see around Elisha?
explanation: God's army protected them. “he saw that the hills were full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.” (2 Kings 6:17, BSB)

content: Surrounded by enemies, what did Elisha tell his frightened servant?
explanation: God's army was greater. “for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.” (2 Kings 6:16, BSB)

content: How old was Joash when he became king?
explanation: He was one of Judah's youngest kings. “Joash was seven years old when he became king.” (2 Kings 11:21, BSB)

content: Which empire captured Samaria and carried Israel away?
explanation: It was in Hoshea's ninth year. “the king of Assyria captured Samaria and carried away the Israelites to Assyria” (2 Kings 17:6, BSB)

content: Which king of Judah trusted the LORD so that no king was like him?
explanation: He removed the high places. “Hezekiah trusted in the LORD, the God of Israel.” (2 Kings 18:5, BSB)

content: How many years did God add to King Hezekiah's life?
explanation: God heard his prayer and saw his tears. “I will add fifteen years to your life.” (2 Kings 20:6, BSB)

content: As a sign for Hezekiah, what went back ten steps?
explanation: It was on the stairway of Ahaz. “and He brought the shadow back the ten steps it had descended on the stairway of Ahaz.” (2 Kings 20:11, BSB)

content: When Babylon took Jerusalem, what happened to the house of the LORD?
explanation: The walls were broken down too. “He burned down the house of the LORD, the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem” (2 Kings 25:9, BSB)

content: From which town were Elijah and Elisha traveling just before Elijah was taken up?
explanation: They went on to Bethel and Jericho. “Elijah and Elisha were on their way from Gilgal” (2 Kings 2:1, BSB)

content: How many sons of the prophets watched from a distance at the Jordan?
explanation: They saw Elijah part the water. “Then a company of fifty of the sons of the prophets went and stood at a distance” (2 Kings 2:7, BSB)

content: On the road to Bethel, what did a group of boys jeer at Elisha?
explanation: They mocked the prophet. “Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!” (2 Kings 2:23, BSB)

content: How many sets of clothing did Naaman take to Israel?
explanation: He also took silver and gold. “taking with him ten talents of silver, six thousand shekels of gold, and ten sets of clothing.” (2 Kings 5:5, BSB)

content: What was the name of the bronze snake King Hezekiah destroyed?
explanation: People burned incense to it. “He also demolished the bronze snake called Nehushtan that Moses had made” (2 Kings 18:4, BSB)

content: How many years did Hezekiah reign in Jerusalem?
explanation: He became king at twenty-five. “and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years.” (2 Kings 18:2, BSB)

content: How many Assyrians did the angel of the LORD strike in one night?
explanation: God defended Jerusalem. “and struck down 185,000 men in the camp of the Assyrians.” (2 Kings 19:35, BSB)

content: What did Isaiah have placed on King Hezekiah's boil?
explanation: Hezekiah recovered. “Prepare a poultice of figs.” (2 Kings 20:7, BSB)

content: Which high priest found the Book of the Law in King Josiah's day?
explanation: He gave it to Shaphan the scribe. “Then Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe” (2 Kings 22:8, BSB)

content: Which scribe read the newly found Book of the Law to King Josiah?
explanation: The king tore his clothes. “And Shaphan read it in the presence of the king.” (2 Kings 22:10, BSB)

content: Who was the Babylonian captain of the guard who burned Jerusalem?
explanation: He served the king of Babylon. “Nebuzaradan captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, entered Jerusalem.” (2 Kings 25:8, BSB)
